WITH trader_record_counts AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS a
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink
  JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
)
SELECT tradekind, record_count,
       1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share_of_total
FROM trader_record_counts;
